writerSelfReport.whatThisIs: the writer's own account of raising one toast. It is NOT the witness: nothing here reads the Action Center, and this process cannot see whether the notification was drawn. The graded evidence is the registry the platform wrote.

writerSelfReportIsNotEvidence: the shell process reporting that the platform accepted a Show. Graded by nothing here: a process reporting its own effect is the shape DEF-072 was about. It is carried so a reader can see the two accounts side by side.
correctsDefect: DEF-082 said the Action Center could not be read without a packaged app holding the userNotificationListener capability. Measured on this host, an unpackaged process with no package identity reads it and is granted access without a prompt. The LISTENER.unpackaged arm below asserts that rather than restating it.
notMeasured: WHO raised the toast - UserNotification.AppInfo throws NotImplementedException for an unpackaged caller, so attribution here is the payload text inside a time window this run opened, and not a publisher identity
that pressing a toast button re-activates the process through the registered activator - nothing here can press one, and DEF-082 keeps that half
